description: Analyze the local run history (.playwright-e2e-mcp/history.jsonl, written by every run and load-report): 'flaky' ranks tests that flip pass/fail and lists broken or regressed ones; 'patterns' groups failures by cause; 'test' shows one test's timeline; 'slow' ranks durations and slowdowns; 'trend' shows stability per day; 'commits' names the commit where each failing or flaky test went bad.

source.description: With a Pro key: 'both' (default) merges this machine's runs with CI runs from Pro Cloud; 'cloud' or 'local' for one side

test.description: Filter: substring of file or title

view.description: Default 'flaky'; 'slow' ranks durations, 'trend' is per day, 'commits' names the commit each test went bad

name: analyze-history
title: Analyze run history
